title: Nashville Escape - Steps to Lake, 20 min to DownTn
description:
Welcome to Nashville - Music Capital of the World! Our home is the perfect combination of modern amenities, Nashville charm, and adventure. 

Each room is equipped with a private bath, closet, premium linen,  and all essentials to feel at home. Enjoy beautiful sunrises - or sunsets - on the rooftop balcony with a fire pit. 

The location is one block from Turtle Bay Marina and the lake, 10 min. from BNA International Airport, and within 20-25 min. of most major Nashville attractions.

The space
The home is conveniently located within 10 minutes of BNA International Airport and within 20-25 minutes to most major Nashville attractions.

Enjoy a beautiful sunset from our rooftop deck, while staying warm with the gas firepit. 

A dedicated parking space is available for guests.

Extra speedy wifi included!

Guest access
1st Floor: Garage and downstairs bedroom. 

2nd Floor: Kitchen, Dining Room, Living Room.

3rd Floor: Primary Bedroom and second bedroom. 

Rooftop deck: Enjoy a beautiful sunrise or sunset, while staying warm next to the gas firepit. A gas grill is also located on the rooftop for cooking.

Guests have one dedicated parking space, along with ample street parking.

Other things to note
We’re here to host you and your group! We’re excited to share our home with you, and we ask that all guests respectfully follow a couple simple rules:

1) Home is 100% smoke free. Evidence of smoking results in a $500 fee.

2) The city has a strict noise ordnance after 10pm. We want you to enjoy the space and have fun, while also respecting the community. Any noise complaints to the city will result in a $500 fine. (This is the fine we have to pay to the city as hosts.)

3) Guests are responsible for any damage that occurs during the trip. 

This is all pretty basic stuff. We hope you enjoy your stay and make many lasting memories in our hometown. 🎸🎵
